name: tweeter-desktop
author: Baran Uyukus
description: Desktop interface for Tweeter account and publishing workflows.

scripts.check: python3 -m py_compile tweeter.py ui_api.py ui_live.py ui_config.py && node --check desktop/main.js && node --check desktop/preload.js && node --check desktop/renderer/app.js
scripts.build:py: python -m PyInstaller --clean --onefile --distpath py-dist --workpath py-build --name ui_api ui_api.py && python -m PyInstaller --clean --onefile --distpath py-dist --workpath py-build --name ui_live ui_live.py
